verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs say you can always export your notes into open formats such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder repeated this on HN as the answer to lock-in concerns. That covers the core of the story: exporting at any time in open formats. Both sources are first-party, and the docs give only a single line on export. Missing for 10: confirmation that a whole-knowledge-base export covers attachments and images, detail on whether backlinks and tags survive the export, and independent or hands-on reports of a successful full export and migration.
